en.answer:
They cannot activate it.

This is because, if the hand is currently being revealed, the『Reveal 1 monster in your hand』resolution of <<16555>> cannot be performed.

If the hand is currently being revealed due to the effect of <<4987>>, <<23162>>, <<4958>>, <<14887>>, <<4928>>, <<6119>>, <<18817>>, <<8539>>, or <<7334>>, the following example effects cannot be activated:

~~~

Monster effects:
● <<18003>>'s ②nd effect
● <<12555>>'s ②nd effect
● <<22952>>'s ①st effect
● <<22560>>'s ③rd effect
● <<10271>>'s effect
● <<23416>>'s ②nd effect
● <<14409>>'s ①st effect

~~~

Spell effects:
● <<10121>>'s effect
● <<14778>>'s ①st effect
● <<13616>>'s ②nd effect
● <<15876>>'s ①st effect
● <<14507>>'s ②nd effect
● <<14506>>'s ②nd effect
● <<16541>>'s ①st effect
● <<15407>>'s ②nd effect
● <<12340>>'s ②nd effect
● <<12005>>'s ①st effect
● <<11727>>'s ①st effect
● <<12037>>'s ②nd effect
● <<16544>>'s ①st effect
● <<16545>>'s ②nd effect
● <<16012>>'s ①st effect

~~~

Trap effects:
● <<6361>>'s effect
● <<18859>>'s ①st effect
● <<13365>>'s ①st effect
